title: LLMail-Inject: A Dataset from a Realistic Adaptive Prompt Injection Challenge
abstract: arXiv:2506.09956v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Indirect prompt injection attacks exploit a fundamental weakness of LLMs: executing unauthorized tasks from untrusted sources. Despite the practical significance of this attack vector, existing benchmarks rely on small sets of template-based attacks (100-1,000 examples) that fail to capture the diversity and adaptiveness of real-world adversaries. Consequently, benchmarks are saturated and overfit to static attacks. We introduce LLMail-Inject, a large-scale benchmark of 208,095 distinct human-written attack prompts collected through a public red-teaming challenge with 839 participants. LLMail-Inject evaluates the attack's complete chain of execution: prompts must be retrieved from an email database, evade production-level defenses, and trigger unauthorized tool calls with correct arguments. Evaluation reveals that models that achieve 5% attack success rate (ASR) on existing benchmarks fail more on LLMail-Inject: Meta SecAlign--

translated_title: LLMail-Inject：来自现实自适应提示注入挑战的数据集
translated_abstract: 间接提示注入攻击利用了大语言模型的一个根本弱点：执行来自不受信任来源的未授权任务。尽管这种攻击向量具有重要的实际意义，但现有基准测试依赖于小规模的基于模板的攻击集（100-1,000个示例），无法捕捉真实世界攻击者的多样性和适应性。因此，这些基准测试已经饱和，并对静态攻击产生了过拟合。我们提出了LLMail-Inject，这是一个大规模基准测试，包含通过一项有839名参与者参加的公开红队挑战收集的208,095个独特的人工编写的攻击提示。LLMail-Inject评估攻击的完整执行链：提示必须从电子邮件数据库中检索、规避生产级防御，并以正确的参数触发未授权的工具调用。评估结果显示，在现有基准测试中达到5%攻击成功率（ASR）的模型在LLMail-Inject上失败率更高：Meta SecAlign——
tldr: 本文提出了LLMail-Inject，一个包含208,095个人工编写攻击提示的大规模基准测试，通过真实红队挑战收集而成，用于评估间接提示注入攻击的完整执行链，克服了现有小规模模板化基准饱和且过拟合的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces LLMail-Inject, a large-scale benchmark of 208,095 human-written attack prompts collected through a realistic red-teaming challenge, which evaluates the complete execution chain of indirect prompt injection attacks and overcomes the saturation and overfitting of existing small template-based benchmarks.
